meta.description: Aaron Ryan Shamika - software engineer with backend experience in Node.js, TypeScript, C#/.NET and SQL Server.

basics.name: Aaron Ryan Shamika
basics.title: Software Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript)
basics.summary: Software engineer with backend experience in Node.js and TypeScript, including an HR management web app serving 500+ employees, plus C#/.NET and SQL Server work supporting around 600 users. Looking to grow as a full-stack JavaScript engineer on the MERN stack. I enjoy learning new technologies, tackling challenges under pressure, and contributing through adaptability and teamwork.

highlights: Managed and supported ClickHome and Databuild, third-party Australian construction management applications, for around 600 users, troubleshooting 10-20 support tickets per day.
Wrote custom SQL Server stored procedures and functions to maintain the applications and automate workflows based on user requests.
Automated document uploads with a stored procedure that runs overnight via Groveller, loading files from the server into ClickHome by job number and sparing users the manual upload process.
Built reports with Crystal Reports and SSRS tailored to users' data needs.
Developed 3 custom plug-ins for AutoCount using C# with .NET framework and AutoCount API. Fixed and updated legacy projects.
Mentored 2 interns on AutoCount API and .NET framework, onboarding them to the code repository and how it is managed.
Developed backend for HR management web app serving 500+ employees using NodeJS, TypeScript with AdonisJS
Automated 20+ functionality tests using Selenium IDE, saving significant time
Introduced AdonisJS built-in functions, establishing code quality standards and consistency
Used conventional commits for clear Git history

projects.name: Cardfight!! Vanguard Simulator
highlights: Building a fan-made, fully automated browser version of the card game, with a rules engine that resolves every phase, check, trigger and guard
Implemented abilities for 1,254 cards through an ability interpreter with one handler per condition, timing, cost and effect, so a new mechanic is a new entry
Added a rule-based AI opponent, a deck builder and a scraper that generates the card data, structured as an npm workspaces monorepo with a Vitest test suite

projects.name: Road Crack Detection System
highlights: Developed an application that detects road cracks and potholes with 70-90% accuracy using a Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN)
Enabled drone-based road inspections, saving civil engineers time checking roads

projects.name: Horror Soccer Game
highlights: Implemented physics for ball movement and player interactions
Led team project, assigning tasks by individual strengths

education.degree: Bachelor in Computer Science (Computer Graphic & Multimedia Software)
